description: Points a domain at a page on lton.io, so the page opens at the domain. The proof group adds the TXT record that proves the domain to Cloudflare for SaaS, which serves lton.io's custom domains; it is applied only while that proof is asked for. hostRequired is set only because a CNAME at @ requires it.
variableDescription: handle: the page's handle on lton.io, for example alice for alice.lton.io; proof: the ownership verification value Cloudflare for SaaS issues for the domain (a UUID)
